correctness.rationale: A unit-determinant integral minor indexed by every 2-cell makes ∂2 injective and primitive, independently of finite experiments. This proves H2=0 and H1 torsion-free; connected 1-skeleton fixes H0. Full signed cellular W_n modules cancel in the rational alternating-chain identity, giving ∧²B_n^0⊕(B_n⊗A_n). Its character and quotient invariants follow from exterior-square traces and rational transfer. All 4,280 group elements for n=2 through 5 were exhaustively checked with exact signed cubical boundaries; the proof handles every n≥2.

originality.rationale: The new object-level invariant is the full character for all wreath automorphisms, including independent petal reflections. Ko–Park and Maciążek–Sawicki give homology ranks or decompositions but not this group action. published-finding corpus analogues use a matching complex or exchange-sign Borel–Moore homology, which do not imply this ordinary rational representation. Relevant accessible prior claims were compared. No known covering implication was found; unindexed work remains a priority risk.
